d:
In this video, we take you through the *Jainamore–Gola Section of the Jainamore–Ormanjhi Expressway,* a major greenfield highway project being developed in Jharkhand under the *Raipur–Ranchi–Dhanbad Economic Corridor (EC-07).*
The entire Jainamore–Ormanjhi project is approximately *60 km long & is being developed in two packages:
• Package-1: Jainamore–Gola — approx. 32.5 km*
• Package-2: Gola–Ormanjhi — approx. 27.8 km*
In this video, we cover the Jainamore–Gola section from near *Gola to Jainamore,* showing the current construction progress through detailed drone & ground footage.
